title: colutea arborescens var. brevialata
intro: Colutea arborescens var. brevialata, commonly known as Sensitive Plant or Touch-Me-Not, is a plant species in the family Fabaceae. This plant is known for its delicate, fern-like foliage and is native to tropical and subtropical regions. The health benefits of Colutea arborescens var. brevialata include its potential anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may aid in the treatment of various diseases. The bioactive constituents of the plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiproliferative effects.
